messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

John, here's the update the team got for you. Your Magic M. 40T on Shop···· hasn't shipped yet, and I'm sorry it's now past the November 14 date. All 300 units from this production run are on their way to our warehouses in the US, Canada and the EU. A realistic ship date for your order is November 30. Your Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA is on the same order.

Tracking will be emailed to (email hidden) as soon as your miner ships. You can follow the stock on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
Now that harlo is is not available for this miner and you have missed the arrival date, I would like to cancel this order and receive a refund

I understand, John. You bought it partly for Harlo OS, and we missed the date. Both of those are on us.

I've paused your order so nothing moves while we sort this out. Your 40T is being built for you, and what you paid has already gone into that unit. It ships November 30, about two weeks from now.

If you'd rather not wait, I can turn the full $839.00 into store credit for anything in stock. Or I can swap it for a Thor P2 ($349, 10 TH/s), which is in stock and ships within 2 business days.

Would either of those work for you?

Fair enough, John. I get that the firmware change and the missed date have both cost you confidence in this order.

One more thing worth weighing. The hardware is the same as when you ordered. On its stock firmware it runs up to about 42 TH/s as normal use, and that's still the best value per TH we sell. Your unit is already built for you and ships November 30. Store credit would also keep every dollar of your $839 if you want something else later.

What would make keeping it work for you?
I may cancel my h15 as well if that doesn't ship on time

Your Harlo H15 Dual on Shop···· is waiting on stock at our US warehouse, John, and it ships November 30.

On the 40T, I have one last offer. If you keep the order, we'll refund $100 of it to your original payment. The team approves that refund, and they'll confirm it with you once it's done. Your miner still ships November 30.

Would you like to keep it on those terms?
I will, if the miner does not ship on November 30th 2026, I will want a full refund no questions asked!
Handed to the team · Partial refund needs approval; special request on a conditional refund; hold rel

Thank you for staying with us, John. Your order stays as it is, and the 40T ships November 30. I've passed the $100 partial refund to the team, and they'll confirm it with you shortly.

I can't promise a full refund ahead of time myself, so I've given your condition to the team as well. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email.

Tracking will be emailed to (email hidden) as soon as your miner ships.
please send a copy of this chat to my email

Yes, John. A copy of the whole chat goes to (email hidden) when we finish here. You can reply to that email to reach us again.

The team will also confirm the $100 refund and give you an answer on your November 30 condition by email.
